ambiguity.detail: The flash-forward drops the viewer into a prison cell without context for why Juliana is there.
Lady Catherine Ashbridge is mentioned via an invitation, but her connection to the plot is mysterious.

verdict.cliffhanger_line: To every woman who thinks she can rise above the place she was given.
verdict.viewer_takeaway: An imprisoned woman bravely faces her impending fate while her cruel social superiors celebrate an upcoming wedding and execution.
verdict.why_it_works: The flash-forward cold open creates immediate high stakes before jumping back to explain the villains' sadistic plans.
